findings.statement: The specification uses «Д=» for pipes («Д=57х3,5» under ГОСТ 10704-91, «Д=50х3,5» under ГОСТ 3262-75), «Д=» and «Ду» for the same fitting code («Отвод 90-2-57»), and «Ø» for grooved fittings with codes such as 060. The diameter type is not defined anywhere in the supplied text, so the threshold «≤ 50 мм» in REQ-03 cannot be mapped reliably to rows. Do not infer it from catalogue codes. Request the diameter convention from the designer and have the Norm Resolver confirm the standards' size designations.

findings.statement: Many lines carry «<варианты>» in the position or code cell («Врезка du15», «Врезка du25» and others, «Отвод 90 … Ду 65»). Quantities and variants are not final, so quantity-based comparisons are unreliable.

findings.title: The «recommended as analogue» note limits brand-level comparisons but not technical parameters
findings.statement: The footnote on every specification sheet says marks and brands are non-mandatory and replaceable by analogues with preserved technical parameters. Dinarm codes therefore cannot serve as hard design requirements. Parameters such as joint type and size still bind, but the specification does not list them. The «*» also appears on ГОСТ 8957-75 and ГОСТ 17375-2001 lines, so the extent of replaceability for these standard-based items is unclear.
